photos.desc: Dionaea muscipula 'Dracula', a Venus flytrap cultivar with blood-red interiors and fine, dense marginal teeth giving the appearance of fangs. Cultivated specimen.
Images of my mother Venus Flytrap at the end of a summer, with her belly full of sunlight and bugs.
Dionaea muscipula at the University of Helsinki Botanical Garden
